changeSet.author: opencode
changeSet.comment: Append-only log of field visits to a household (door check-ins) with the officer and the reported position.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE household_visit ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY, request_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE, household_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES household(id), hamlet_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES hamlet(id), outcome varchar(16) NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('PRESENT','ABSENT')), observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), officer varchar(255) NOT NULL, officer_subject varchar(255) NOT NULL, latitude double precision, longitude double precision, accuracy_m double precision CHECK (accuracy_m IS NULL OR accuracy_m >= 0), note varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', CONSTRAINT ck_household_visit_position_pair CHECK ((latitude IS NULL) = (longitude IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT ck_household_visit_position_range CHECK (latitude IS NULL OR (latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180)) ); CREATE INDEX ix_household_visit_household ON household_visit(household_id, observed_at DESC); CREATE FUNCTION household_visit_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'household_visit is an append-only log'; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER trg_household_visit_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON household_visit FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION household_visit_immutable(); COMMENT ON TABLE household_visit IS 'Append-only field visit log; one row per door check-in';
